title: ShankConnectionInterface
description: Mirrors backend/jewelmind/geometry/connection.py::ShankConnectionInterface exactly — the explicit, named handoff between the Shank subsystem and RingHead component builders (prongs, basket). Every field stays exact for a tapered shank too: taper always preserves the full base width/thickness exactly at the head (u=0), so topZMm never moves. See docs/bible/19-shank/550-head-connection-interface.md.

topZMm.description: The Z coordinate of the shank's top surface at the head (u=0), matching geometry/constants.py::band_top_z(). This is where prong/basket geometry begins.

embedMm.description: The fixed embed depth (EMBED_MM in geometry/constants.py) prongs/basket sink into the shank for a robust boolean union — a kernel/manufacturing-adjacent constant, not a jewelry-domain rule threshold.

headCenterRadiusMm.description: The radial distance from the ring axis at which prong/basket centers are placed, matching geometry/constants.py::prong_center_radius().
